# Enter AI

Enter AI is a dark, AI-native enterprise project management MVP.

## Structure

- `frontend/`: Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind UI.
- `backend/`: FastAPI modular monolith, SQLAlchemy, Alembic.
- `qa/`: Playwright, Schemathesis, K6, OWASP ZAP, dependency-check runners.

## Local commands

```sh
docker compose up --build
cd frontend && npm run dev -- -p 6767
cd backend && uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000
```

The demo account is `admin@demo.enterai.com` / `enterai-demo`.

## AI safety

AI reads workspace data and proposes writes. Task creation and updates require explicit confirmation through `/api/ai/confirm`.

## Uploads

Project briefs accept PDF, DOC, DOCX, TXT, MD, XLSX, CSV, and JSON. Files are stored through `backend/app/storage.py`; local disk is the default and a cloud adapter can be added behind the same boundary.
